reviews.text: Liz is absolutely wonderful! She took the time to truly listen to what I wanted, and her coloring skills are exceptional. I couldn't be happier with the results and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a talented and attentive stylist.
I’ve been in Texas over 4 years and have been to so many stylists, but Caitlyn nailed it!! I finally found my hair person! She crushed the color and was a joy to chat with while getting my blonde on!

I’m so blessed to have found Lesly and appreciate the time and detail she spends on making me feel beautiful. My hair has never looked so good and I was so relaxed and pampered while at Texas Blonde Society. I’m so happy I did the consultation and leap of faith! Don’t wait - book now!
